changes: Fixes #329: muting Scene A or B (FUNC + SCENE A/B) now stops that scene’s MIDI locks, as stock scene mute does for audio tracks.
With one scene muted, the crossfader morphs between the base value and the other scene. With both muted, the CC returns to its base or trig-lock value.
Editing scene locks while holding a muted scene’s key still works, as on stock.
Fixes out-of-range CC values from the crossfader when a scene has nothing assigned.
Known issue: editing a scene lock while holding its key does not send the CC until you move the crossfader.
Now uses the author’s own MIDISC2.0 release unchanged, and can be built in the browser.
Known issue: MIDI Scenes must be selected alone; it cannot yet be combined with other modules.
Documentation only: adds screenshots of the selection and control pages and explains how to open them.
Documentation only: the module page describes the author’s MIDISC2.0 features, such as pre-trig scenes, held trig locks and CCs sent before notes.
Builds still contain the earlier version of the module; these features are not in this release yet.
MIDI Scenes can now be built in the browser.
First Modwerk release of the MIDI scene-lock patch (based on 1.40MIDISC8.2), with scene A/B crossfader morphing and Part save and reload.
